summary: Private deployment: intermittent 403s for SSO users after IdP certificate rotation
description:
Issue summary:
Customers on Stratus Bank private deployment began seeing intermittent 403 Forbidden responses when attempting to authenticate via SSO. Failures started immediately after the customer's IdP certificate rotation window. Impact: ~30% of their users unable to complete SSO login; affects both console access and API calls that rely on SAML assertion-based tokens.

Impact:
- Business impact: Stratus Bank internal users cannot access critical dashboards and some API-driven features return authorization failures.
- Scope: Production (us-east) private deployment for Stratus Bank. Estimated 350 active users; around 100 affected on initial report.

Environment:
- Deployment: Redwood Private (customer-managed control plane) running v2026.01.3
- Auth config: SAML 2.0 IdP integration, X.509 certs with automatic rotation configured on IdP side, Redwood configured with OIDC adapter for SAML bridging.
- Regions: us-east (primary)

Steps to reproduce:
1) Attempt SSO login to Redwood Console using Stratus corp account (Okta-based IdP).
2) Observe redirect to IdP and successful authentication at IdP.
3) After redirect back to Redwood, authentication fails with 403 on assertion exchange or immediately on token swap.
4) API calls using freshly minted user tokens return 403 when calling protected endpoints.

Observed behavior:
- 403 Forbidden with error message in gateway: "invalid_assertion" or "signature_verification_failed" in ~30% of requests.
- Patterns indicate some IdP-signed assertions not being accepted by the private control plane.

Expected behavior:
- All valid SAML assertions from the customer's IdP are accepted and user sessions established.

Logs / relevant snippets:
- Gateway logs show repeated failures: "saml: signature validation failed: certificate does not match trusted fingerprint"
- Audit logs show alternating success/failure for the same user within short time windows.
- IdP confirmation: IdP rotated primary cert at 2026-03-10T02:15Z and published metadata that includes both old and new certs for 48h.

Initial hypothesis:
- The private control plane is still caching the old IdP certificate fingerprint in its SAML verifier and not fully picking up the new cert during IdP rotation, causing a subset of authentication requests to be validated against the old cached cert (which fails). Intermittent success suggests a multi-replica cache inconsistency or race during metadata refresh.

Temporary workaround suggested to customer:
- Retry logins when failures observed (some succeed as replicas refresh).
- As immediate mitigation our SRE triggered a manual metadata refresh on the affected control-plane nodes and confirmed transient improvement.

Work completed so far:
- Support verified IdP rotation timestamp and metadata availability.
- Performed manual metadata fetch and forced cache invalidation on three control-plane replicas.
- Coordinated with SRE to watch for recurrence and to capture relevant trace IDs.

Next steps / requested from customer:
- Confirm whether their IdP has any load-balancing / geo-routing that might present different metadata to separate sessions.
- Share example SAML assertions and the exact user email(s) for failed attempts (pseudonymized if required).
- Allow temporary maintenance window to restart a control-plane pod if needed.
investigation_notes:
Timeline: 2026-03-10 02:15Z IdP rotated cert. 02:40Z first customer report. 03:10Z Support triaged. 04:00Z manual metadata refresh performed. Findings: signature verification errors correspond to verifier using old cert fingerprint. Hypothesis supported by per-replica cache TTL behavior; two of five replicas still serving old fingerprint until forced refresh. Reproducible locally by loading previous metadata snapshot against current assertion. Root cause likely: cache invalidation bug in metadata fetcher + race during automatic refresh after rotation. Also uncovered missing metric exposing 'saml_metadata_age' per replica.

Action items created:
- INT-441: Add replica-level saml_metadata_age metric and alert when age > 5m after IdP metadata change.
- INT-444: Fix cache invalidation race in metadata fetcher (PR referenced).
- SUP-9089: Follow-up with customer to validate once fix is deployed.

2026-03-10T04:10Z - Stratus Bank (Customer): Confirmed IdP rotation completed and metadata exposes both certs for 48h. Shared example authz failures and SAML assertion (pseudonymized).
2026-03-10T05:25Z - Carlos Mendes (SRE): Manual refresh improved success rate to ~95% but occasional 403 still reported. Collecting traces and comparing replica states.
2026-03-11T09:12Z - Engineering (Auth Team): Reproduced race in staging; drafted fix for cache invalidation. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/control-plane/pull/782

resolution: Partial: manual metadata refresh and targeted replica restarts restored normal authentication for majority of users; ongoing fix merged to address cache invalidation race. Customer agreed to maintenance window 2026-03-13 02:00Z for rolling restart. Permanent fix scheduled in next patch release (v2026.02.1). Post-deployment monitoring added and new metric 'saml_metadata_age' instrumented to alert on stale metadata. Customer noted restoration of service in follow-up call but will confirm full resolution after maintenance window.
